_doc: Team precision settings. One source for the module (rules crate include_str!), the Python side and the web app. `param: true` settings are mirrored into the Params spreadsheet under the same alias so geometry can bind to them (Params.tol_clearance).

settings.label: General clearance between mating parts
settings.help: Gap left between parts that slide or sit together (lids, slots, pockets).

settings.label: Slip fit (shaft in a hole that turns or slides)
settings.help: Added to a hole's diameter for a shaft, pin or bearing that should slide in by hand.

settings.label: Press fit (negative = interference)
settings.help: Added to a hole's diameter for parts that are pressed in and should hold (bearings, magnets, inserts).

settings.label: Bolt clearance holes (ISO 273)
settings.help: How much bigger than the bolt a through-hole is: close (M3 to 3.2), normal (3.4), loose (3.6).

settings.label: Threads in printed parts
settings.help: How screws hold in plastic. Drives the hole size standard parts and agents use.

settings.label: XY size compensation
settings.help: Holes print small and outlines print big on most printers; offset outer walls by this much.

settings.label: Thinnest wall allowed
settings.help: The printability check flags walls thinner than this.

settings.label: Layer height
settings.help: Heights snap to whole layers when agents size printed features.

settings.label: Mesh deviation (STL export and 3D previews)
settings.help: Largest distance a mesh may stray from the true surface. Smaller is smoother but bigger.

settings.label: Mesh angular deflection
settings.help: Largest angle between neighbouring mesh facets on curved faces.

settings.label: Smallest clash reported
settings.help: Overlaps smaller than this volume are ignored by the clash check.

settings.label: Decimals in the part editor
settings.help: How many decimal places the Edit a part dialog shows and accepts.

settings.label: Arrow-key step in the part editor
settings.help: How far one click of a size or position arrow moves.

settings.label: Default material
settings.help: What parts are made of unless a task says otherwise (strength checks and suggestions use it).
